create_FrozenEstimator: create a FrozenEstimator that wraps a fitted estimator to prevent re-fitting in a pipeline
build_frozen_predict: build predictions using a FrozenEstimator that delegates predict to the wrapped fitted estimator
test_FrozenEstimator_fit: test that calling fit on a FrozenEstimator is a no-op and returns self without refitting
review_FrozenEstimator_set_params: review FrozenEstimator.set_params to verify it only accepts 'estimator' key and rejects inner params
summarize_FrozenEstimator_get_params: summarize FrozenEstimator.get_params which returns a dict containing only the wrapped estimator
